decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 166158, so no exact duplicate rows require removal.

year, month, day, dep_time, sched_dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, sched_arr_time, arr_delay, flight, air_time, distance, hour, and minute all show integral DECIMAL(38,9) sample_values, justifying a cast to INTEGER.

purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the bronze nyc_flights capture of 2013 domestic flight departures from New York airports, casting decimal-encoded numeric fields to integers and standardizing the time_hour timestamp, to feed downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analytics.
usage: Consumers should join or filter on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) for per-flight analysis, and must deliberately handle nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum, which represent cancelled or unresolved flight legs rather than data-entry gaps.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the roughly 2.9%-3.3% null rates in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time, nor the 0.9% null rate in tailnum; these are retained as nulls rather than imputed. The dataset's duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 means no deduplication logic was applied.
